lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's thirty-six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 36? Nope!

lines.text: A regular hexagon is cut into twenty-four small triangles.
lines.caption: A regular hexagon is cut into 24 small triangles.

lines.text: How many triangles of any size are in the figure?
lines.caption: How many triangles of any size are in the figure?

lines.text: Here's a shortcut. Count only the triangles pointing up. Twelve little ones.
lines.caption: Here's a shortcut. Count only the triangles pointing up. 12 little ones.

lines.text: Six with side two, and one big one. That's nineteen pointing up.
lines.caption: 6 with side 2, and one big one. That's 19 pointing up.

lines.text: Now turn the hexagon upside down. It looks the same, so nineteen triangles point down too!
lines.caption: Now turn the hexagon upside down. It looks the same, so 19 triangles point down too!

lines.text: Thirty-six was the trap. It misses the two big ones.
lines.caption: 36 was the trap. It misses the 2 big ones.

lines.text: Did you get thirty-eight? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 38? Tell me below!
